What You’ll Own (Key Responsibilities)
Market & Growth 
* Build and execute the city go to market: micro market mapping, pincode coverage, funnel & beat plans.
* Deliver monthly and quarterly targets for investments volume (₹), number of FDs, number of Bonds, number of mutual funds, active customers, and repeat investments.
* Drive investment wallet growth via cross sell/upsell, portfolio deepening, and city level campaigns.
Channel & Partnerships
* Acquire, activate, and scale channel partners (IFAs, DSAs, wealth boutiques, community leaders, housing societies, corporates etc).
* Run partner onboarding, training, joint customer events, incentive governance, and performance hygiene.
* Maintain high partner productivity (activations, conversion %, average ticket size, compliance score).
* Direct Sales & Customer ExperienceLead from the front in high stakes customer meetings; close marquee customers/accounts.
* Ensure top tier NPS: zero-defect KYC/documentation, quick TATs, and clear communication.
Team Building & Leadership 
* Hire, train, coach, and manage 5–10 field sales reps (minimum 2 years prior team handling required).
* Institute a rigorous operating rhythm: daily huddles, weekly reviews, funnel hygiene, pipeline building, sales commitments, and capability building.

* Own city P&L: productivity, CAC, ATS,  incentives, vendor spends, and unit economics.
* Be a stickler for process - CRM hygiene, pipeline data, sales commitments, input metrics, and SOP adherence.
* Ensure regulatory compliance (KYC/AML/PMLA) and audit readiness; drive clean, documented operations.
Data, Reporting & Collaboration
* Track inputs → outputs: leads → meetings → commitments → investments → renewals.
* Publish weekly/monthly dashboards; flag risks early and propose fixes.

* Mutual Fund Volume (₹) & #MFs booked; average ticket size; wallet deepening/retention

CAC & city unit economics, marketing ROI, incentive efficiency
Customer NPS

About the role
Stable Money is looking for a dynamic and results-driven Outbound Telesales Executive to promote and sell Fixed Deposit (FD) & Bonds investment options to potential customers. ● Fixed salary + attractive performance-based incentives.
● Training on financial products and sales techniques.
● Career growth opportunities in the financial services industry.
● Friendly and supportive work environment.

About Stable Money
Stable Money is India's leading fixed-income investment platform, on a mission to modernize
how 230+ million Indians save and invest. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in
Bengaluru, we've grown to over 30 lakh users who have collectively invested more than
₹5,000 crore across fixed deposits, bonds, and other secure instruments, all in under three
years.
 
Our platform lets users book FDs without opening a savings account, access instant
withdrawals, invest in short-term instruments (including 7-day FDs), and discover curated
fixed-income portfolios through a digital experience designed around speed and clarity.
Right now, our team is working on deepening direct partnerships with banks and NBFCs,
building on-ground presence in key cities, and expanding into adjacent savings products, all
while maintaining the trust-first approach that has defined us since day one.
 
Our Investors
Backed by $65 million in total institutional funding from marquee investors including Peak
XV Partners, Z47, RTP Global, Fundamentum, and Lightspeed, we recently closed a $25
million Pre-Series C round to accelerate our next phase of growth. We're building the
operating layer for how India saves, making fixed-income products transparent, accessible,
and worthy of trust.
 
Our team
Saurabh Jain is a graduate from IIT Bombay who has previously worked as the CEO of Navi
Mutual Fund and was leading Swiggy’s expansion into 500+ cities.
Harish Reddy is a graduate from IIT Bombay and has deep expertise in building wealth
product strategy. He was leading product strategy and the tech implementation at Estee
Advisors. Both founders have extensive experience in wealth-tech businesses and
complement each other to help build a scalable and value accretive business

About Stable Money
 
Stable-Alpha aims to build India's most trusted wealth tech platform, focusing on fixed-income investments. We're here to offer tailored solutions to retail investors that maximize and generate predictable returns, coupled with a sacrosanct focus on risk reduction.
The household financial assets in India are overwhelmingly dominated by fixed income instruments and are typically low yielding, tax inefficient products. Alternate fixed income products are nuanced and often complex, which presents an opportunity for a platform like ours to simplify fixed income investing for the end user through discoverability, demystification and analytics driven custom fixed-income portfolios. The tailwinds of a rising interest rate environment and a choppy stock market makes this a great time for a platform like ours to be launched into the market.
 
Program Manager - Repeat & Retention

We're looking for a sharp generalist to own repeat and retention for Fixed Deposit and Recurring Deposit Category on Stable Money. You'll map the full post-booking experience — from maturity reminders and renewal flows to RD instalment journeys — identifying where users drop off or disengage and working crossfunctionally to fix it. Your north stars are reinvestment rate and NPS, and you'll be directly accountable for moving them.
 
What you'll own
  • Reinvestment rate and NPS for FD and RD users — tracking trends, diagnosing root causes, and driving improvement initiatives end-to-end
  • Deep-dive into repeat flows on the app — FD maturity and renewal journeys, RD instalment drop-off, top-up and upgrade behaviour
  • Cohort-level retention analysis — first-time vs repeat investors, ticket size segments, issuer preferences, tenure patterns
  • Identify friction in the post-booking experience that leads to non-renewal or churn — notifications, communication, app UX, trust signals
  • Own the maturity lifecycle: ensure users receive the right nudges at the right time to reinvest, and that the reinvestment flow is seamless 
  • Partner with product, growth, and partnerships teams to define and ship retention-improving interventions across FD and RD
  • Build the feedback loop between user signals — support tickets, app ratings, NPS verbatims — and the teams responsible for fixing them
  • Own retention reporting for FD and RD — weekly dashboards, stakeholder summaries, and deep-dives as needed
 
What we're looking for
  • 2–3 years in strategy, ops, consulting, or a high-ownership generalist role —consumer fintech, BFSI, or savings/investment product exposure preferred 
  • Genuinely willing to get hands dirty — comfortable doing ground-level ops work, speaking with users directly, and chasing down issues across teams
  • Strong analytical instincts — cohort analysis, funnel metrics, retention modelling; SQL or BI tool experience preferred

About Stable Money
Stable Money is India's leading fixed-income investment platform, on a mission to modernize how 230+ million Indians save and invest. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bengaluru, we've grown to over 30 lakh users who have collectively invested more than ₹5,000 crore across fixed deposits, bonds, and other secure instruments, all in under three years. 
Backed by $65 million in total institutional funding from marquee investors including Peak XV Partners, Z47, RTP Global, Fundamentum, and Lightspeed, we recently closed a $25 million Pre-Series C round to accelerate our next phase of growth. We're building the operating layer for how India saves,  making fixed-income products transparent, accessible, and worthy of trust. 
Our platform lets users book FDs without opening a savings account, access instant withdrawals, invest in short-term instruments (including 7-day FDs), and discover curated fixed-income portfolios through a digital experience designed around speed and clarity. Right now, our team is working on deepening direct partnerships with banks and NBFCs, building on-ground presence in key cities, and expanding into adjacent savings products, all while maintaining the trust-first approach that has defined us since day one.

Saurabh Jain is a graduate from IIT Bombay who has previously worked as the CEO of Navi Mutual Fund and was leading Swiggy’s expansion into 500+ cities. 
Harish Reddy is a graduate from IIT Bombay and has deep expertise in building wealth product strategy. He was leading product strategy and the tech implementation at Estee Advisors. Both founders have extensive experience in wealth-tech businesses and complement each other to help build a scalable and value-accretive business.

About Stable Money
 
Stable Money is India’s leading fixed investment platform. It is a marketplace which helps customers discover and invest in
high-quality fixed-income products such as Fixed Deposits (FDs), RD, Bonds, Credit Cards, Mutual Funds from trusted institutions. Stable Money has 30 lac+ trusted investors, 2000cr+ bookings since inception and is backed by marquee investors such as Z47, Lightspeed, Fundamentum, Matrix Partners, RTP Global to name a few.
 
Role Overview
We are seeking high-performing and well-networked Stable Wealth Managers to acquire high-value retail customers and drive investments into Stable Money products such as Fixed Deposits, Corporate Bonds, and Mutual Funds.
* Target ticket size per customer: ₹5–10 lakhs
* Expected to bring strong personal client networks
* Full ownership of acquisition, closure & client relationship
* Performance-driven role with high growth & incentive potential
 
Key Responsibilities
* Acquire and onboard high-net-worth retail clients using prior industry connects and networking.
* Drive investments in Fixed Deposits, Bonds, and Mutual Funds in the range of ₹5–10 lakhs.
* Build and maintain strong sales pipelines using CRM and structured sales processes.
* Negotiate and close deals independently with minimal support.
* Leverage personal relationships to acquire customers.
* Ensure accurate MIS tracking, compliance adherence, and timely closures.
* Meet and exceed aggressive monthly and quarterly targets.
* Work under target pressure with a high ownership and growth mindset.
 
Candidate Profile
* Minimum 5 years of client acquisition experience in banks, NBFCs, securities firms, or liability-based products.
* Strong track record of customer acquisition, relationship management & sales closure.
* Must carry rich customer contacts and active networks.
* Familiar with sales rigor, process orientation & CRM usage.
* High ownership, negotiation skills, resilience under pressure.
* Graduate / MBA preferred.
* Local city experience & network (must have worked in the same city you’re applying for).
* Proven direct sales to retail customers
* Strong command of sales process, CRM, funnel metrics, and on ground execution.
* Fluency in English + local language.
 
What Great Looks Like (KPIs you’ll be measured on)
* FD Volume (₹) & #FDs booked; average ticket size; wallet deepening/renewals
* Bond Volume (₹) & #Bonds booked; average ticket size; wallet deepening/renewals
* Mutual Fund Volume (₹) & #MFs booked; average ticket size; wallet deepening/retention
* Lead to Sale Conversion %, cycle time (TAT), cancellation/error rate
Customer NPS
 
Skills & Traits We Value
* Hunter mindset with high ownership; thrives in the field.
* Excellent negotiation, closing, and partner management skills.
*Data-driven; strong Excel/Google Sheets; comfortable with CRM tools.
* High integrity, compliant by default; clear written & verbal communication.
* Flexibility to run weekend drives/events when needed.
 
Operating Rhythm 
* Daily: stand-ups, beat execution, customer meetings, CRM updates.
* Weekly: pipeline reviews, field immersions, customer connects, marketing events.
* Monthly/Quarterly: target vs achieved, plan for next month.
 
Compensation & Benefits
* Competitive fixed + performance-linked incentives
* Best in the industry Medical Insurance coverage for self and dependents
* Travel reimbursements as per policy.
